surface: gh plate ci audit + plate_core.ci_audit + docs/design/ci-audit-command.md
summary: Add `gh plate ci audit` to split recent Actions jobs into waiting, setup, and running minutes with optional cache hints (#1282).
migration_impact: Additive CLI only. Adopters run `gh plate ci audit [--limit N] [--json]` against their repo; no workflow or branch-protection changes.
migration_guidance: Ensure `gh` is authenticated with Actions read access for the target repository.
Run `gh plate ci audit --json` locally or from a scheduled procedure when baselining CI minutes.
Read docs/design/ci-audit-command.md for setup/test step heuristics before acting on numbers.
agent_notes: Workflow motivation credited in docs to Owen Gretzinger's Oct 2026 X post on Boardy CI analysis (see issue #1282); PLATE heuristics and output are original. Complements research #1271 and feeds future nightly audit procedures under #1268.
